messages:
alice: paging oncall - seeing a sudden tail-latency spike on the hosted inference cluster, started ~10m ago. Customer-facing errors for a few customers. Incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-15-KVCACHE-BATCH. Severity: P1. Notifying oncall-2.

oncall-2: looking. getting logs now, can someone post service/region?

alice: us-west-2, model pool 'g4dn-llm-1'. Error is 503 with 'timeout during KV cache load' in the agent logs.

ben: seeing high KV cache eviction/excessive cache miss churn in metrics. Cache size jumped from 120GB -> 520GB for a subset of keys. That caused continuous batching queues to stretch and starve small short requests.

carmen: confirmed: batch scheduler shows long-running batches dominated by huge prefix-populate requests (long seqs). Short 1-2 token requests are waiting 300-1000ms now. Fairness metric (max wait / median wait) is 30x.

oncall-2: this matches the customer complaints. Which change rolled recently? Any deploys?

alice: last deploy was 01:15 UTC to runtime with KV prefetch refactor. Rollout 30% at ~01:20.

david: rollback flag available? We can toggle new-prefetch via config service. If we disable the new prefetch path, it should reduce cache blowups.

incident-bot: Deployment 2026-03-15/runtime-prefetch v2 -> rollout 30%. Marked as potential cause by alert correlator.

oncall-2: ok plan: 1) short-term mitigation: route short requests to a small isolated pool (fast-path) and throttle long prefetch batches. 2) revert prefetch flag if needed. 3) scale dedicated pool as fallback. I'll implement 1 now.

ben: adding a per-model batch-size cap and request-duration cap helps scheduler fairness. Pushing a hotpatch to scheduler config in prod: set max_batch_size=32, max_batch_latency_ms=40 for impacted pool.

carmen: pushing the hotpatch now. command: ```./opsctl set-config --pool g4dn-llm-1 --key scheduler.max_batch_size --value 32 --env prod```

oncall-2: confirmed config applied. Observability shows batch sizes dropping immediately. Short request latency median improved from 320ms -> 70ms within 2 mins.

alice: customer error rate trending down too. But KV cache mem is still high for some nodes - eviction thrash ongoing.

ben: we should also disable the new prefetch path to stop new cache blowups. Toggle flag: `runtime.prefetch_v2.enabled=false`. I'll stage the change.

david: staging toggle in 2 mins. Oncall-2, do we want to notify customers or wait for stability?

oncall-2: notify customers on impacted accounts: quick note that we've mitigated latency for most requests, investigating root cause and will post a postmortem. Add a short incident status.

incident-bot: Status update posted to INC-2026-03-15-KVCACHE-BATCH. Channels: #customers-impacted, #status.

ben: toggle applied to 60% roll and then global. Command: ```./opsctl feature-toggle set runtime.prefetch_v2.enabled false --rollout 100 --env prod```

carmen: after toggle reached 100%, KV cache growth rate dropped. Nodes freed ~260GB over 8 minutes. Batch scheduler fairness is back to normal (max/median wait ~2x).

elaine: running a controlled canary for the prefetch fix to validate. Also capturing traces for the offending long requests so we can craft a regression test.

oncall-2: handing over to SRE shift B (elaine) for follow-up and postmortem. I will annotate timeline and action items. Oncall-2 handing off at 02:10 UTC.

elaine: thanks - I'm taking this. Action items: 1) preserve traces and cache dump for 10 nodes, 2) run a load test mixing 95% short requests + 5% long seqs to reproduce, 3) add automated scheduler fairness guard (abort batch if wall time > X ms).

alice: also add a customer-impact audit: list of customers that saw >5% error increase during window. Ops: export from logs.

ben: quick note: the root cause looks like a bug in prefetch v2 where certain prefixes were incorrectly treated as unique, causing massive key expansion and cache population. We'll include code diff in postmortem.

carmen: long-term: add per-request kv-populate budget, enforce async backpressure, and treat large-prefetch as background workers not in the latency-critical scheduler.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: primary mitigation applied, service healthy. Resolution: disabled prefetch_v2 + scheduler caps. Time to resolution: ~18 minutes. Postmortem task created: PM-2026-0315-KVCACHE.

elaine: following up now with the artifacts and will schedule postmortem doc. Leaving this thread open for final notes.

oncall-2: thanks everyone. If you touched config, please add change IDs to the incident doc. :thumbsup:

alice: added change refs. Closing shift notes.

incident-bot: Reaction summary: :thumbsup: (5), :eyes: (3).
